name: MuslimInk
author: fiqsr
changelog_id: Perbaikan Lockscreen: Mengatasi ayat & hadist panjang yang terpotong di bagian bawah layar lockscreen
Ekspansi Ruang Vertikal: Merampingkan layout jam, tanggal, kartu sholat berikutnya, dan timeline sehingga area kutipan bertambah +70px (164px+ bersih)
Penskalaan Teks Adaptif: Jarak baris (line height) dan celah referensi otomatis menyesuaikan jumlah baris secara dinamis
Proteksi Overflow: Memastikan teks referensi surah/hadist selalu tampil utuh dan aman di dalam batas layar 800px
changelog_en: Lockscreen Quote Fix: Resolved long Quranic verses and hadith cutoff at the bottom of the lockscreen
Vertical Space Expansion: Re-budgeted clock, capsule, next prayer card, and timeline for +70px extra quote budget (164px+ clean space)
Adaptive Line Spacing: Line height and reference gap automatically scale dynamically to fit multi-line quotes
Overflow Protection: Guarantees verse/hadith references are always rendered completely within the 800px display boundary
